impacts.description: LICENSOR shall make a first delivery of Content to plan_b within 14 days after the signing of this Agreement unless separately agreed between the Parties.
LICENSOR shall deliver Content according to the specifications set by plan_b or to be agreed between the Parties in writing.
LICENSOR grants plan_b the right to produce, market and distribute Content to End Users through its own and its partner's platform for the term of this Agreement.
plan_b will distribute Content to End Users in the Territory through its distribution channels.
plan_b shall use reasonable commercial efforts to market and stimulate interest in the Content with its customers.

changes.description: A new clause has been added requiring plan_b to pay the LICENSOR within 30 days of each delivery, establishing a clear payment term that was not previously specified.
